lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a repeating vertical-to-horizontal grid-like formation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity clearly intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank displaying a sharp luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs observed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, predominantly clustered toward the anterior margin and mid-section.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of associated Echeneidae individuals visible below the ventral midline and posterior to the pectoral fin.
